truth.claim: exact chance of a run of 7+ in 100 fair flips: 54 %
truth.note: independent DP over current run length gives 0.5423; 5+ = 0.9717; <=4 = 0.0283

truth.claim: 1,000 seeded rows: 546 with 7+, 33 at 4 or less, 967 longer than 4; bins 33/158/263/244/150/82/33/23/8/6
truth.note: all 49 formulas recompute from mulberry32(1985); bins sum to 1,000; 244+150+82+33+23+8+6 = 546; expected 542, 28 and 972 from the exact distribution, so the sample is within noise (stated in the honest limits)

truth.claim: GVT 1985: 100 fans, 91 of 100, 61 after a hit / 42 after a miss for a 50 % shooter, 76ers 1980-81
truth.note: Gilovich, Vallone & Tversky 1985 Study 1 and 2 as cited

truth.claim: Miller & Sanjurjo: 0.46 after three heads in 100 flips

defects.what: The 1,000 rows arrive as falling dots that read as noise for a few seconds before they stack; the bin labels (84, 68, 44) are mid-count
'YOUR 4 · 33 AT OR BELOW' and '967 RAN LONGER' are stacked above the leftmost bar in two sizes; crowded against '7 OR MORE: 546 OF 1,000'
The fans frame carries a 100-square grid, three bars and three numbers at once; the most structures of any beat

one_line: Ten rows with the longest run boxed, then a thousand stacked into a pile the guess sits on: the best count of the batch, and the exact odds check.
